missionSettings.description: Challenging co-op mission where PALA provokes the BDF navy, and must defend Vigil Cay airbase from a naval attack.

outcomes.Message: We need to re-establish control of the strait. Sink some BDF ships!
A ship has been sunk. The Boscali Navy is moving to attack the island.
Sink the ships before they get within firing range of the island!
All BDF ships are headed to the bottom of the strait - now we can take back South Boscali!
Stand down. We're surrendering Vigil Cay to the BDF.
We're back on the offensive - excellent work!
We're losing factories! If this keeps up we're done for!
